claim: Verify Sites readiness as separate gates: exact assembled bytes, in-memory migrated schema and history query plans, isolated child runtime paths and cancellation cleanup, HTTP status before JSON parsing, owner access, deployment, plugin installation and authenticated MCP calls. A UI error repair is not an OAuth repair; preserve original prompt and memory bytes, retain migration history, and establish rollback before first publication.

decisions.notes: Canonical capture of the readiness lesson documented in PT PR 428; verified by local assembly, schema, Worker acceptance and authenticated MCP evidence. Browser login and hosted two-account acceptance remain distinct and unverified. Preserve the retired docs log without adding a new renderer target.
